formula: NLL(s,i) = -log softmax(logits(model(s with only residue i replaced by MASK))[i,:])[original_token(s_i)]
denominator: ESM-2 full vocabulary softmax probability of the original standard amino acid; no canonical-amino-acid renormalization.
scope: 6305 original ungapped natural residues; exact mapping to frozen 218 alignment columns; no scoring of gaps or BOS/EOS
provenance: User supplied Claude final scientific definition in this session, 2026-11-15.
column_aggregation: col_nll[c] = arithmetic mean of singleton-mask original-residue NLL over observed standard residues at column c
sequence_aggregation: ppl[s] = exp(arithmetic mean NLL over all ungapped standard residues of the full-length natural sequence)
